tendon_geometry: tendon_profiles.csv: control points (station, height of the duct centre above the soffit measured vertically, slope of that height with station); between two control points the height is one parabola in station; a web duct lies in the mid-plane of its web, a bottom-slab duct at its stated offset from the girder axis

calibration.note: rising pressure, against a reference load cell; force delivered to the strands at the anchor head
rising pressure, against a reference load cell; force delivered to the strands at the anchor head

load_cells.position: at the passive (dead) end, between anchor head and bearing plate
load_cells.stage_0: reading of the cell before the jack was pressurised

stressing.extension: ram travel at each stage from the reference mark made on the ram at 20 %; the jack first grips the tight strands with its ram closed and is never run out of stroke between stages: at a stage hold, after the reading, if the travel to the next stage would not fit in what is left of the stroke, the anchor wedges hold the strands while the ram closes and grips again; the travels of all strokes are added up
stressing.draw_in: at each lock-off, marks made on the strands just behind the gripping wedges of the jack while it held the full force; draw_in_mm is how far the marks moved towards the anchor head, read after the jack had been released and taken off

force_asked_for.state: the force the strands of that tendon carry in the cross-section at that station after all lock-offs of that tendon, before elastic shortening and long-term losses
